summary: Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, killing three according to Palestinian media. Iran conducted multiple missile launches and air defense activations across Khuzestan, Isfahan, East Azerbaijan, and Kurdistan provinces, including from the 15 Khordad Garrison and Omidiyeh Fifth Tactical Air Base. Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam and the Education Minister condemned an IDF Arabic spokesperson's visit to a school in Dbl, South Lebanon, calling it a violation of children's rights.
key_points: Israeli military struck three PIJ operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, killing three per Palestinian media. (Source: @manniefabian/59570)
Iran launched missiles from 15 Khordad Garrison in Isfahan and a UAV from Omidiyeh Fifth Tactical Air Base in Khuzestan. (Source: @shin_persian/12745, @shin_persian/12756)
Heavy anti-aircraft activity reported in Omidiyeh, Khuzestan and Dorcheh, Isfahan. (Source: @shin_persian/12751, @shin_persian/12750)
Missile launched from Payam area near Marand police road, East Azerbaijan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12755)
Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam condemns IDF visit to school in Dbl, South Lebanon. (Source: @N12chat/236453)
Bahrain Interior Ministry issues alert after smoke seen and ambulances dispatched. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10319)
Greece and Israel discuss arms deals up to 1 billion euros including electronic warfare systems and long-range missiles. (Source: @yediotnews25/138316)
Lebanon monitoring report shows 75 alerts, down 53% from previous day, concentrated in Nabatieh and Tyre districts. (Source: @redlinkleb/54507)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, killing three according to Palestinian media. Iran conducted multiple missile launches and air defense activations across Khuzestan, Isfahan, East Azerbaijan, and Kurdistan provinces, including from the 15 Khordad Garrison and Omidiyeh Fifth Tactical Air Base. Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam and the Education Minister condemned an IDF Arabic spokesperson's visit to a school in Dbl, South Lebanon, calling it a violation of children's rights.

points: A missile was launched from the Payam area near the Marand police road in East Azerbaijan Province, indicating possible military activity in northwestern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12755)
Heavy anti-aircraft fire was reported in Omidiyeh, Khuzestan Province, suggesting heightened air defense readiness near strategic oil infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/12751)
A UAV was launched again from the Omidiyeh Fifth Tactical Air Base in Khuzestan Province, demonstrating continued drone operations from this facility. (Source: @shin_persian/12756)

Two missiles were launched from the 15 Khordad Garrison in Isfahan Province, a known air defense and missile base, signaling potential training or operational deployment. (Source: @shin_persian/12745)
Anti-aircraft firing occurred in Dorcheh, Isfahan Province, further indicating widespread air defense activity across central Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12750)
A launcher was observed on the Saghez-Baneh road in Kurdistan Province, suggesting mobile missile or artillery positioning in western Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12749)

The Israeli military conducted a strike on three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in the Tel al-Hawa neighborhood of Gaza City, killing three according to Palestinian media, and stated they were falsely presented as aid workers. (Source: @manniefabian/59570)

IDF Arabic spokesperson Lt. Col. Avichay Adraee visited a middle school in Dbl, South Lebanon, prompting condemnation from Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam and the Lebanese Education Minister for violating children's rights and school neutrality. (Source: @N12chat/236446, @N12chat/236453)

Greece and Israel are negotiating arms deals worth up to 1 billion euros, including electronic warfare systems, long-range missiles, and expansion of the pilot training center in Kalamata operated by Elbit Systems. (Source: @yediotnews25/138316)

Former U.S. President Trump stated he may renew war with Iran after the new year if no deal is reached, and threatened that Iranian ships attempting to break a blockade would find themselves at the bottom of the sea. (Source: @yediotnews25/138332)

Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, with Palestinian media reporting three killed; the IDF said the operatives were falsely presented as aid workers. (Source: @manniefabian/59570)

Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam condemned the IDF Arabic spokesperson's visit to a school in Dbl, South Lebanon, calling it a violation of children's rights and an exploitation of students for propaganda. (Source: @N12chat/236453)

The Lebanese Education Minister's office denounced the event, stating it occurred over a month ago without the ministry's knowledge, and affirmed schools are for learning, not military displays. (Source: @N12chat/236446)

Daily monitoring recorded 75 alerts across Lebanon, including 31 drone sightings and 23 artillery strikes, concentrated in Nabatieh district (26 alerts), Tyre district (19), and Marjayoun district (10), a 53% decrease from the previous day's 161 alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/54507)

Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Hajir, and an Israeli drone exploded in a field near the residential cooperative in Shukin, Nabatieh district. (Source: @redlinkleb/54513, @redlinkleb/54479)
Bahrain's Interior Ministry issued an alert of potential threat after smoke was observed and ambulances dispatched to an unspecified location in Bahrain. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10319)

U.S. Central Command denied Iran's claim that its air defenses damaged an American F-16 over the Gulf, stating Iran did not attack an F-16 and all U.S. fighter aircraft in the Middle East are accounted for. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10314)
Trump threatened that Iranian ships attempting to break a maritime blockade would be sunk, indicating a potential escalation in Gulf maritime security. (Source: @yediotnews25/138332)

sections.threat_assessment: Israeli kinetic operations in Gaza continue targeting Palestinian Islamic Jihad leadership, while Iran demonstrates widespread missile and air defense activity across multiple provinces, suggesting either heightened readiness or testing. The IDF's school visit in South Lebanon has provoked high-level Lebanese condemnation, potentially complicating civil-military dynamics in the border area. Bahrain's unspecified threat alert and CENTCOM's denial of Iranian F-16 claims indicate persistent Gulf tension. Trump's rhetoric about renewing war with Iran adds strategic uncertainty.
sections.regional_response: Lebanon's political leadership uniformly condemned the IDF school visit, framing it as a violation of international norms protecting children. Greece is advancing major defense procurement with Israel, signaling deepening military cooperation. Bahrain's alert suggests Gulf states remain on edge regarding Iranian or proxy actions. The Lebanese monitoring network shows a significant drop in daily alerts but sustained artillery and drone activity in the south.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iran's simultaneous missile launches from Isfahan and UAV operations from Khuzestan, coupled with AA fire in multiple provinces, may indicate a coordinated exercise or response to perceived threats. The launcher sighting in Kurdistan Province suggests mobile deployment capabilities. The spoofed Iranian tanker report highlights ongoing information warfare in maritime domain. The decrease in Lebanese alerts could reflect a temporary lull or reporting changes rather than reduced threat.
